summary: Iteration 8 — Emergent Google Auth integration. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass (validation, password auth regression, merge-by-email logic via DB, simulated Google JWT wishlist flow). Frontend: Google buttons present on /login (google-login-btn), /register (google-register-btn), /profile guest (google-profile-btn). Click on /login button redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>%2Fprofile (URL-encoded, dynamic origin, NOT hardcoded). /profile#session_id=fake-abc-12345 triggers AuthCallback and falls back to /login on invalid session with no JS crash. Simulated Google user (JWT cookie per /app/auth_testing.md) can access /profile (shows name), /wishlist, add/remove wishlist via API (200 OK), and logout clears the access_token cookie. Mobile 390px: bottom-nav visible, Google button renders full-width.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1600 lines — approaching maintainability threshold, consider splitting into routers (auth, destinations, partners, itineraries, payments, share) in a future iteration.
auth-callback: on invalid session AuthCallback still calls navigate('/login') AND window.history.replaceState — the replaceState is a no-op right before navigate but harmless.

google_session merge branch does not clear stale auth_provider field when a password account gains a Google identity — cosmetic, does not affect functionality; consider $set auth_provider='hybrid' or leaving as-is.
test_credentials: admin@wisatasumut.id / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Google OAuth cannot be automated end-to-end; simulated via JWT cookie per /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Test users created and deleted inline within pytest fixtures (test_iter8_*@example.com, gtest_*@example.com, mergeadmin_*@example.com, gwish_*@example.com). No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google auth integration verified: (1) backend /api/auth/google/session validates payload (422 for missing/short session_id, 401 for invalid session, never 500); (2) merge logic keeps single user by email + preserves role — verified by direct DB assertion on unique index and merge $set operation; (3) password login untouched; (4) frontend buttons wired with dynamic window.location.origin redirect (do NOT change to hardcoded — playbook forbids it). To simulate a Google session in Playwright, mint a JWT with backend JWT_SECRET and set as access_token cookie (see /app/auth_testing.md). Wishlist toggle selector on DestinationDetail is data-testid='wishlist-toggle-btn'.
